lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption (hint, redesign), choose_path (copy, hint, new_screen), finish (incentive, layout, redesign), and sign_in (copy, hint, layout, reorder) changes, as each has only 1 test.
adoption copy, choose_path layout, finish new_screen, and home wait_info changes each have at least 2 tests agreeing that no clear effect was seen.
home new_flow and sign_in notification changes can be helpful since at least 1 test won for each kind, though other tests showed no clear effect.
Most changes tested so far (23 out of 27 tests) showed no clear effect.
Predictions generally overestimated impact for most tests, but underestimated the size of major wins.

candidates.title: Desktop Dock Pre-Summon Interactive Flow
candidates.change: Inserts an interactive preview screen before waiting completes where users test dragging and waking their pet on a simulated desktop bar.
candidates.why: Home drop-off takes a median of 201s and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or interact with the pet once spawned.

new_dock_intro.headline: Practice Controlling Your Desktop Companion
new_dock_intro.body: Try moving and clicking your pet on the desktop bar while setup finishes.

guard.reason: All required onboarding steps are retained in order, and adding an interactive pre-summon dock preview screen inside onboarding is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from funnel delay and support tickets; past new_flow tests showed potential, but high build cost.

candidates.title: Path Overview Split Card Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the path selection screen into a full-bleed comparison card layout highlighting preset companion versus custom photo creation.
candidates.why: Path decision mean duration is 514s and evidence is thin for choose_path layout changes.

path_options.text: Instant Pet vs Custom Photo Pet

components.text: Right click for menu; Double click to pet; Drag to move across monitors

candidates.score_note: High evidence of confusion at finish, but new_screen tests consistently showed no clear effect.

candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in with a different account.

components.text: Please sign in with your original email to restore previously created pets.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.components[0].text' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Background Desktop Environment Diagnostics Info
candidates.change: Shows live diagnostic status messages while preparing the pet on desktop during the waiting screen.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pet not showing or app failing to launch, while waiting screen has 201s median time.

waiting.hint: Checking multi-monitor support and desktop display layers...

guard.reason: Adding background diagnostic status updates to the waiting screen preserves its function of showing the pet is being prepared.

candidates.score_note: Addresses launch issues on home step, but historical wait_info tests failed to show clear impact.

candidates.title: Choose Path Processing Time Hint
candidates.change: Adds an explanatory hint below path selection indicating photo pets take 1-2 minutes while presets are instant.
candidates.why: Median choose_path duration is 8s but mean is 514s, indicating uncertainty before selection.

choose_path.hint: Preset pets load instantly. Photo generation takes around 60 seconds.

guard.reason: Providing an accurate processing time hint on the path selection screen is informative and compliant with fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint for path delay, but previous choose_path hint tests performed poorly.

home_intro.body: Look at the bottom corner of your primary screen. Your pet is now exploring your desktop.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Completion Notification Sound
candidates.change: Plays an audio chime and shows a desktop toast notice when background pet generation completes.
candidates.why: Lessons show home notification changes can be helpful, and mean waiting time is 2336s.

guard.reason: Adding a ready chime and completion notification to the waiting screen enhances status feedback without violating any rules.

candidates.score_note: Targets long home wait times; notification changes have shown positive potential in prior tests.

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for adoption (hint, redesign), choose_path (copy, new_screen), finish (copy, incentive, layout, redesign), and sign_in (copy, hint, layout, reorder) changes, as each has only 1 test.
home new_flow and sign_in notification changes can be helpful, as tests in both categories produced significant wins.
adoption copy, choose_path layout, finish new_screen, and home wait_info changes consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
choose_path hint changes showed no clear effect or performed worse across multiple tests.
Most changes tested (24 out of 29) showed no clear effect or performed worse.
Predictions generally overestimated impact for changes with no clear effect, but underestimated the size of major winning redesigns.
